name: jev-cua
description: Run bounded computer-use workflows through a local Cua Driver and TypeSafe Jev fast path.

interface.longDescription: Runs structured UI subgoals in a local observe-decide-act-verify loop. Cua Driver owns desktop interaction, Jev selects only allowlisted action IDs, and uncertain or consequential actions return to Codex or the user.
defaultPrompt: Run this bounded browser workflow with Jev Cua.
Check whether Jev Cua is ready on this Mac.
Use the fast path and stop before consequential actions.
